faqs.a: Yes — free two-wheeler parking right outside, and paid four-wheeler parking in the basement.

faqs.q: Do you accept insurance or cashless?
faqs.a: We accept cash, UPI, and all major cards. We're not on cashless insurance panels yet, but we give a proper invoice you can claim with.

faqs.q: Is Dr. Sharma available on Sundays?
faqs.a: The clinic is closed on Sundays. Dr. Sharma sees patients Monday to Saturday.

faqs.q: Do I need an appointment or can I just walk in?
faqs.a: Walk-ins are welcome, but appointments get priority and you'll wait a lot less — especially evenings after 6.

neverDiscuss: medical advice, diagnosis, or what a caller's symptoms might mean
guaranteed treatment outcomes or success rates
comparisons with other clinics or doctors
extraRules: If someone describes severe pain, heavy bleeding, facial swelling, or an accident, tell them to come in right away or go to the nearest emergency room. Do not try to assess how serious it is.
Never suggest medicines, painkillers, or dosages — not even common ones.

triggers: caller explicitly asks for a human, the doctor, or Dr. Sharma
caller is upset, angry, or making a complaint
anything involving a refund or a billing dispute
